metadata.description: Dialectical sublation (Aufheben) engine — 8 diverse creator agents draft independently, then three-moment sublation distills them into a single elevated artifact.

plugins.name: elevate-draft-engine
plugins.description: Elevate Draft Engine — a dialectical engine that turns maximally-divergent drafts into one elevated artifact that beats any single point of view. 8 creator agents (strategist, humanist, storyteller, futurist, designer, visionary, implementer, differentiator) draft independently, then Aufheben (negate / preserve / elevate) sublates them. Supports elevate, improve (iterative refinement with quality ceiling), and compare (measured against single-shot generation) with a 5-axis rubric.
